rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something unfavorable or working against someone's interests.

example.english: This policy is highly adverse to small businesses.
example.traditional: 呢個政策對小商戶好不利。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 deoi3 siu2 soeng1 wu6 hou2 bat1 lei6

rows.note: Use this for an adverse or negative effect, opinion, reaction, or criticism rather than for active hostility.

example.english: That report caused a lot of adverse reactions.
example.traditional: 嗰篇報道引起咗好多負面反應。
example.jyutping: go2 pin1 bou3 dou6 jan5 hei2 zo2 hou2 do1 fu6 min6 faan2 jing3

rows.note: Use this when adverse means harmful, especially to health, safety, or well-being.

example.english: Eating too much processed food is adverse to your health.
example.traditional: 食太多加工食品對身體有害。
example.jyutping: sik6 taai3 do1 gaa1 gung1 sik6 ban2 deoi3 san1 tai2 jau5 hoi6

rows.note: Use this only when the adverse force or attitude is actively hostile or opposing.

example.english: The other side maintained an adverse, hostile attitude during negotiations.
example.traditional: 對方一直用敵對態度同我哋談判。
example.jyutping: deoi3 fong1 jat1 zik6 jung6 dik6 deoi3 taai3 dou6 tung4 ngo5 dei6 taam4 pun3
